description: Benchmark Study of Tornado Wind Loading on Low-Rise Buildings with Consideration of Internal Pressure is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Delong Zuo, Texas Tech University (ttu.edu). The goal and the specific objectives of this project will be achieved through implementation of a research plan composed of experimental, analytical and numerical components. This research plan consists of three main tasks. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Tornado wind loading, Internal pressure, Low-rise building. Published 2022-10-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
